description: Build all reusable UI components and implement all page views with full production-quality UI/UX. This includes: ContentCard, ContentGrid, VideoPlayer, SearchBar, TabNavigation, DetailHero, EpisodeList, LoadingState, ErrorState components, plus all page implementations (Home, Movies browse, TV browse, Movie detail, TV detail, Player, Search). UI must be polished with skeleton loading, error states, responsive grid, hover effects, smooth transitions.
steps: Create /apps/web/src/components/LoadingState.jsx - Skeleton loader component with animated pulse effect, supports card grid skeleton (multiple cards) and detail page skeleton. Use gray-100 bg with animate-pulse.

Create /apps/web/src/components/ErrorState.jsx - Error display with icon (AlertCircle from lucide-react), error message, descriptive text, and 'Try Again' button (blue-600 bg, white text, rounded-lg). Centered layout with min-h-[400px].

Create /apps/web/src/components/ContentCard.jsx - Movie/TV card with: poster image (lazy loaded with placeholder), title, year, rating badge, genre pill, ghost border (1px #E5E7EB), rounded-xl (12px), hover:border-gray-300 transition, watch progress bar overlay at bottom if progress exists. Clicking navigates to detail page.

Create /apps/web/src/components/ContentGrid.jsx - Responsive grid layout: grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6 with gap-4/gap-6. Supports loading state (shows skeleton grid) and empty state.

Create /apps/web/src/components/TabNavigation.jsx - Horizontal tab bar with tabs (Latest, Trending, Top Rated, Upcoming for movies; Latest, Trending, Top Rated for TV). Active tab: border-b-2 border-blue-600 text-gray-900 font-medium. Inactive: text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700. Uses -mb-[1px] overlapping border technique. Border-b on container.

Create /apps/web/src/components/SearchBar.jsx - Search input with Search icon (lucide-react), placeholder 'Search movies and TV shows...', debounced input (300ms), search history dropdown (last 10), clear button. Styled with ghost border, rounded-xl, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600.

Create /apps/web/src/components/DetailHero.jsx - Detail page hero section: large backdrop/poster, title overlay, rating, year, genre tags as pills, overview text, Play button (blue-600), runtime info. Responsive layout.
Create /apps/web/src/components/EpisodeList.jsx - TV show episode selector: season dropdown/tabs, episode grid/list with episode number, title, thumbnail. Click to play episode.

Create /apps/web/src/components/VideoPlayer.jsx - iframe wrapper for vaplayer.ru embed. Full-width responsive container (16:9 aspect ratio), handles postMessage events from player, tracks progress every 5s, stores in playerStore and localStorage. Back button to return to detail.

Implement Home page (/apps/web/src/app/home/page.jsx): Continue Watching section (horizontal scroll of cards with progress), Trending Movies row, Trending TV Shows row. Uses React Query for data fetching with loading/error states.

Implement Movies browse page (/apps/web/src/app/movies/page.jsx): TabNavigation (Latest, Trending, Top Rated, Upcoming), ContentGrid with infinite scroll pagination (24 items per page), loading skeleton on initial load, load more on scroll/button.
Implement TV Shows browse page (/apps/web/src/app/tv/page.jsx): TabNavigation (Latest, Trending, Top Rated), ContentGrid with pagination, same pattern as movies.

Implement Movie Detail page (/apps/web/src/app/movies/[id]/page.jsx): Fetches movie detail from API, shows DetailHero with all metadata, Play button navigates to player. Loading skeleton while fetching.

Implement TV Detail page (/apps/web/src/app/tv/[id]/page.jsx): Fetches TV detail, shows DetailHero + EpisodeList with season/episode selector. Play episode navigates to player with season/episode params.

Implement Player page (/apps/web/src/app/player/page.jsx): Full-screen VideoPlayer component, receives content type/id/season/episode from URL params, constructs embed URL, handles resume from watch progress, back navigation.
Implement Search page (/apps/web/src/app/search/page.jsx): SearchBar at top, real-time results in ContentGrid below, search history display, empty state when no results.

Update root layout with proper responsive navigation: Logo (HIJISTREAM), nav links (Home, Movies, TV Shows), search icon button that navigates to /search. Mobile responsive with hamburger or bottom nav. Active route highlighting.
Add smooth page transitions using CSS transitions or framer-motion-lite patterns
Ensure all images use lazy loading with IntersectionObserver or loading='lazy' attribute, with gray placeholder during load
Verify: All pages render correctly, navigation works, responsive at all breakpoints (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop 1920px)
acceptance_criteria: All 9 components (ContentCard, ContentGrid, VideoPlayer, SearchBar, TabNavigation, DetailHero, EpisodeList, LoadingState, ErrorState) are created and functional
Home page shows Continue Watching and Trending sections
Movies page has working tab navigation between Latest/Trending/Top Rated/Upcoming with paginated grid
TV Shows page has working tab navigation between Latest/Trending/Top Rated with paginated grid
Movie detail page shows full metadata with play button
TV detail page shows metadata plus episode list with season selector
Player page embeds vaplayer.ru iframe and tracks progress
Search page has debounced search with real-time results
All pages have loading skeleton states
All pages have error states with retry functionality
UI uses Inter font, ghost borders, blue-600 primary, proper spacing
Responsive grid works at all breakpoints
npm run build succeeds with all components
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
Verify all component files exist in /apps/web/src/components/
Verify all page files exist in /apps/web/src/app/
findings: Used Bun for build (bun run build). All 9 reusable components and 7 page views implemented. Build succeeds cleanly with proper code splitting. Used @tanstack/react-query useInfiniteQuery for paginated pages (Movies, TV) and useQuery for detail/search pages. Player page uses existing player.js utilities for embed URL construction and progress tracking.
